summary: Initial full-stack validation completed: all six API regression tests passed and core mobile web journeys loaded and responded.

ui_bugs.issue: An 'Unexpected text node: .' warning/toast appears while viewing the application pipeline; likely an unwrapped raw text node in a React Native tree.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native web preview reports an unexpected text node warning during pipeline display; inspect JSX around pipeline cards and any conditional punctuation/text outside Text.

action_items: Remove the unwrapped text node causing the Calendar pipeline warning.
Update frontend API configuration to use the required EXPO_BACKEND_URL environment key and fail fast rather than falling back to localhost.
Remove backend localhost/database defaults so missing protected environment configuration fails fast.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api/apiClient.ts reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and falls back to localhost instead of using EXPO_BACKEND_URL as specified.
backend/server.py supplies localhost and sarkari_job_portal defaults for MONGO_URL/DB_NAME, contrary to the environment-only configuration requirement.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data; existing demo_candidate and seeded jobs used. Test tracker data was deleted and profile was restored.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at job-portal-govt.preview.emergentagent.com using 375x667 viewport. Home search/sync, Matches, Calendar/pipeline, GK Hub, job detail, gazette modal, and direct apply were exercised.
rca_of_issue: Calendar pipeline navigation reproduced an Unexpected text node warning after switching to My Pipeline. The pipeline JSX contains text-bearing conditional/emoji content and should be audited for any literal text outside Text components.
